name: tt-deploy
description: Diagnose a model launch and verify a running server on Tenstorrent hardware. launch reads the launching container's own log/state to classify hangs and failures, mandatory docker flags, override safety, timing, and displaced services. verify checks health, generation correctness, mesh utilization, throughput/batching, and reasoning-model quirks against a live endpoint, with root-cause elimination when a check fails. Deterministic, evidence-based; every answer traces to a captured log, a live request/response, or a listed static rule. Covers the launch and verification stages of the model-deployment journey; discovery and model retrieval land in a follow-up.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose a model launch and verify a running server on Tenstorrent hardware
interface.longDescription: Diagnose a model launch that is running, hanging, or has failed (launch steps, mandatory docker flags, failure-signature classification, minimum-override selection and safety, override persistence, realistic timing, displaced services), and verify a live server is actually healthy, correct, and performant (health, served model/context, generation correctness, mesh utilization, throughput/batching, reasoning-model checks, root-cause elimination). Deterministic and evidence-based. Discovery and model retrieval skills land in a follow-up release.
capabilities: Launch diagnostics: stage/hang/failure classification from container log and state
Mandatory docker flag and override verification
Server health, correctness, and generation checks
Mesh utilization, throughput, and batching verification
Reasoning-model quirk checks and root-cause elimination
defaultPrompt: Use launch --container <id> to diagnose a model launch that is running, hanging, or has failed, and get a ranked fix.
Use verify --endpoint http://localhost:<n> to check a running server is healthy, correct, and performant.
